description: This file contains functions for statistical analysis and client-side anomaly detection on numeric data matrices, including median, mean, standard deviation, MAD, quantile calculations, and a main function 'detectAnomalies' that identifies outliers based on various methods and options.

methods.name: median
methods.description: Calculates the median of a list of numeric values.

methods.name: mean
methods.description: Calculates the mean of a list of numeric values.

methods.name: stdev
methods.description: Calculates the sample standard deviation of a list of values given the mean.

methods.name: mad
methods.description: Calculates the median absolute deviation of a list of values.

methods.name: quantile
methods.description: Calculates a specified quantile of a sorted list of values.

methods.name: summarizeFeatureContribution
methods.description: Returns the top contributing features based on absolute per-feature scores.
